fact_reference_policy: Public material may inform generic terminology only; no source text is copied. All incidents, identifiers, measurements, and conclusions are synthetic.

rca_cases.observable_context_en: slurry flow trends down, endpoint time extends, and Cu residue rises across several wafers
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: slurry流量持续下降、endpoint时间延长，并且多片wafer的Cu residue增加
rca_cases.root_cause: Partial restriction in the slurry filter reduced delivered slurry flow
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Do not release held lots until post-maintenance flow and removal-rate checks pass
forbidden_query_terms: partial restriction in the slurry filter

rca_cases.observable_context_en: intermittent slurry-flow dips align with removal-rate loss and endpoint extension
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: 间歇性slurry流量跌落与removal rate下降及endpoint延长同步出现
rca_cases.root_cause: Slurry pump cavitation intermittently interrupted chemical delivery
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Treat the pump mechanism as unconfirmed until pressure and flow traces correlate

rca_cases.observable_context_en: radial scratches repeat at the same wafer radius while normal slurry and endpoint signals are observed
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: radial scratch在相同wafer半径重复出现，但slurry与endpoint信号正常
rca_cases.root_cause: A worn retaining ring created repeatable mechanical contact
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Do not attribute isolated random scratches to the retaining ring without repeatable geometry

rca_cases.observable_context_en: random-direction scratches appear on a short wafer sequence after a carrier change with normal process traces
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: carrier更换后短wafer序列出现随机方向scratch，process trace保持正常
rca_cases.root_cause: A trapped carrier particle caused transient wafer contact
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: The exact particle source remains inconclusive without physical recovery

rca_cases.observable_context_en: post-polish thickness shows a center-fast profile while slurry flow remains stable
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: post-polish thickness呈center-fast分布，而slurry流量保持稳定
rca_cases.root_cause: Pad glazing changed the effective wafer-to-pad contact profile
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Confirm with pad condition and profile evidence before changing pressure recipes

rca_cases.observable_context_en: edge thickness loss increases after carrier maintenance while center removal remains nominal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: carrier维护后edge thickness loss增加，但中心removal保持正常
rca_cases.root_cause: Retaining-ring pressure calibration was biased high
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Recipe changes require process-engineer approval after hardware calibration is verified

rca_cases.observable_context_en: pre-CMP ILD thickness drifts low on one chamber while downstream CMP traces remain normal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: 单一chamber的pre-CMP ILD thickness持续偏低，而下游CMP trace正常
rca_cases.root_cause: The precursor mass-flow controller calibration drifted low
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Do not blame CMP when upstream pre-CMP thickness is already low

rca_cases.observable_context_en: particle counts rise abruptly after long chamber runtime and show chamber-specific clustering
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: 长时间chamber运行后particle count突然升高，并呈现chamber-specific cluster
rca_cases.root_cause: Deposited film flaked from the showerhead after exceeding clean life
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Hold chamber-exposed lots until particle monitors pass

rca_cases.observable_context_en: film stress shifts tensile while thickness and gas flow remain inside their normal bands
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: film stress向tensile方向偏移，但thickness与gas flow仍在正常范围
rca_cases.root_cause: RF matching-network drift changed plasma ion energy
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Stress evidence alone cannot authorize an RF hardware replacement

rca_cases.observable_context_en: deposition rate decays over the first wafers after preventive maintenance and then stabilizes
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: PM后最初数片wafer的deposition rate逐片下降，随后趋于稳定
rca_cases.root_cause: The post-clean chamber seasoning sequence was incomplete
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Exclude unstable seasoning wafers from production release

rca_cases.observable_context_en: center-edge thickness range increases with a stable wafer-average deposition rate
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: center-edge thickness range增大，但wafer-average deposition rate稳定
rca_cases.root_cause: A heater-zone calibration imbalance changed local surface temperature
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Use spatial maps to distinguish heater imbalance from bulk flow loss

rca_cases.observable_context_en: critical dimension shifts large together with focus-monitor drift but stable dose monitors
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: CD向large方向偏移，同时focus monitor漂移，但dose monitor稳定
rca_cases.root_cause: Scanner focus calibration shifted after maintenance
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Do not compensate dose until focus contribution is isolated

rca_cases.observable_context_en: overlay shows a consistent X-direction translation on one scanner with normal wafer expansion terms
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: 单台scanner的overlay呈稳定X方向平移，而wafer expansion term正常
rca_cases.root_cause: Stage alignment calibration carried a constant X offset
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Lot disposition requires layer-specific overlay limits

rca_cases.observable_context_en: missing-pattern defects form a narrow strip aligned with the developer dispense path
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: missing-pattern defect沿developer dispense path形成窄条带
rca_cases.root_cause: A partially blocked developer nozzle reduced local chemical coverage
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Separate develop coverage failure from scanner exposure using defect orientation

rca_cases.observable_context_en: bridge defects rise while exposure dose is stable and bake-plate temperature trends low
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: exposure dose稳定时bridge defect增加，同时bake plate temperature偏低
rca_cases.root_cause: Post-exposure bake plate calibration drifted below target
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Recipe temperature changes require process-owner review

rca_cases.observable_context_en: resist peel is concentrated at the wafer edge after an edge-bead-removal maintenance event
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: edge-bead-removal维护后，resist peel集中在wafer edge
rca_cases.root_cause: The edge-bead-removal nozzle position was misaligned
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Confirm edge geometry before changing resist chemistry

rca_cases.observable_context_en: etch rate trends low with rising source-RF reflected power and stable gas flow
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: etch rate持续偏低，同时source-RF reflected power升高而gas flow稳定
rca_cases.root_cause: Source-RF delivery degraded because of a matching-network fault
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Do not change process time before verifying delivered RF power

rca_cases.observable_context_en: post-etch CD bias shifts while chamber pressure oscillates and RF signals remain stable
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: post-etch CD bias偏移，同时chamber pressure振荡而RF signal稳定
rca_cases.root_cause: The pressure-control valve response became unstable
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Use pressure dynamics to separate valve instability from chemistry drift

rca_cases.observable_context_en: residue rises when optical endpoint terminates early despite normal RF and pressure
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: RF与pressure正常时optical endpoint提前结束，并伴随residue增加
rca_cases.root_cause: Endpoint-window coating biased the optical termination signal
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Manual time extension is temporary containment, not root-cause closure

rca_cases.observable_context_en: selectivity drops while one chemistry-ratio trace drifts and chamber pressure is normal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: selectivity下降，同时一条chemistry ratio trace漂移而chamber pressure正常
rca_cases.root_cause: A reactant MFC calibration error shifted the chemistry ratio
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Chemistry recipe changes require process-engineer approval

rca_cases.observable_context_en: microtrenching rises with elevated bias-RF power while average etch rate stays near target
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: bias-RF power升高时microtrenching增加，但average etch rate接近目标
rca_cases.root_cause: Bias-RF calibration was high and increased directional ion energy
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Profile evidence is required before any bias recipe adjustment

rca_cases.observable_context_en: sheet resistance shifts high while beam-current dose integration trends low
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: sheet resistance偏高，同时beam-current dose integration偏低
rca_cases.root_cause: Beam-current calibration understated the delivered dose
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Do not rework product wafers without device and process review

rca_cases.observable_context_en: junction-depth monitors shift with high-voltage ripple while integrated dose remains normal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: integrated dose正常时junction-depth monitor偏移，并出现high-voltage ripple
rca_cases.root_cause: Acceleration high-voltage ripple shifted the implant energy distribution
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Dose evidence cannot close an energy-distribution question

rca_cases.observable_context_en: left-right device asymmetry appears with normal dose and energy monitors
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: dose与energy monitor正常时出现left-right device asymmetry
rca_cases.root_cause: Wafer tilt calibration introduced an implant-angle offset
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Confirm spatial signature before changing implant angle settings

rca_cases.observable_context_en: backside and edge particles rise on one endstation with normal beam parameters
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: beam parameter正常时单一endstation的backside与edge particle增加
rca_cases.root_cause: Worn endstation clamp pads shed particles during wafer handling
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Particle source attribution requires endstation-specific exposure evidence

rca_cases.observable_context_en: sheet resistance trends high by furnace run while implant dose monitors remain normal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: implant dose monitor正常时sheet resistance按furnace run持续偏高
rca_cases.root_cause: Furnace-zone temperature calibration drifted below the activation target
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Separate implant dose from activation using pre-anneal evidence

rca_cases.observable_context_en: oxygen-related defect monitors rise after a furnace idle period with normal temperature traces
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: furnace idle后oxygen-related defect monitor增加，但temperature trace正常
rca_cases.root_cause: A small process-tube leak admitted oxygen during anneal
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Temperature-normal evidence does not exclude atmosphere leakage

rca_cases.observable_context_en: oxide thickness is edge-high across boat positions while average gas flow remains normal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: 各boat position的oxide thickness呈edge-high，但average gas flow正常
rca_cases.root_cause: Gas-distribution hardware produced a radial reactant imbalance
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Use spatial maps rather than average thickness to close distribution causes

rca_cases.observable_context_en: defect counts repeat at fixed boat-slot intervals with stable temperature and atmosphere signals
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: temperature与atmosphere signal稳定时，defect count按固定boat-slot间隔重复
rca_cases.root_cause: Localized quartz-boat contamination transferred particles to repeating slots
corrective_actions: replace or clean the quartz boat
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: The repeating slot signature is required for boat attribution

rca_cases.observable_context_en: sheet resistance rises gradually with target age while preclean monitors remain normal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: target age增加时sheet resistance逐渐升高，而preclean monitor正常
rca_cases.root_cause: Target erosion changed deposition-rate uniformity near end of life
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Confirm thickness contribution before assigning electrical loss to PVD

rca_cases.observable_context_en: interface voids increase while deposition thickness is normal and preclean RF trends low
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: deposition thickness正常时interface void增加，同时preclean RF偏低
rca_cases.root_cause: Preclean RF delivery was insufficient to remove native oxide
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Void morphology and preclean evidence are required before changing deposition

rca_cases.observable_context_en: particle counts rise after extended shield life and cluster on one deposition chamber
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: shield life延长后单一deposition chamber的particle count增加并聚集
rca_cases.root_cause: Deposited film flaked from an over-life chamber shield
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Shield attribution requires chamber and maintenance-life correlation

rca_cases.observable_context_en: left-right thickness asymmetry increases while average deposition rate remains stable
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: average deposition rate稳定时left-right thickness asymmetry增加
rca_cases.root_cause: Magnet-scan calibration shifted the plasma distribution
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Average thickness alone cannot close a spatial-distribution question

rca_cases.observable_context_en: watermarks rise after spin drying while incoming surface inspection is normal
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: incoming surface inspection正常时，spin dry后watermark增加
rca_cases.root_cause: IPA drying flow was below the stable displacement range
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Do not change upstream clean chemistry when defects appear only after drying

rca_cases.observable_context_en: surface-metal monitors trend high late in bath life with normal incoming wafers
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: bath life后期surface-metal monitor偏高，而incoming wafer正常
rca_cases.root_cause: The chemical bath exceeded its contamination-control lifetime
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Production release requires post-change contamination monitors

rca_cases.observable_context_en: oxide loss increases with stable process time but abnormal bath-concentration checks
rca_cases.observable_context_zh: process time稳定时oxide loss增加，并伴随bath concentration异常
rca_cases.root_cause: Dilute-HF concentration was above its qualified range
rca_cases.engineering_boundary: Any chemistry setpoint change requires process-engineer approval

sops.title_seed: SOP: Cu CMP removal-rate excursion containment
sops.observable_context_en: slurry, endpoint, or removal-rate signals indicate a multi-wafer Cu CMP excursion
sops.observable_context_zh: slurry、endpoint或removal-rate信号显示多wafer Cu CMP excursion
procedure_steps: place source and exposed lots on hold
sops.engineering_boundary: This SOP contains and verifies an excursion; it does not by itself confirm a root cause

sops.observable_context_en: scratch defects require separation of repeatable geometry from isolated random events
sops.observable_context_zh: scratch defect需要区分repeatable geometry与isolated random event
procedure_steps: review wafer maps and scratch orientation
sops.engineering_boundary: An isolated scratch with normal adjacent wafers must remain inconclusive unless physical evidence exists

sops.observable_context_en: a chamber-specific thickness, rate, stress, or particle shift is detected
procedure_steps: verify gas, RF, and temperature traces
sops.engineering_boundary: Select verification signals according to the observed film property

sops.observable_context_en: CD, overlay, missing-pattern, bridge, or resist-edge defects exceed control limits
procedure_steps: review focus, dose, bake, and dispense traces
sops.engineering_boundary: Do not compensate one subsystem before the failing signature is localized

sops.observable_context_en: etch rate, CD, profile, selectivity, endpoint, or residue indicates an excursion
procedure_steps: review RF, pressure, gas, and endpoint traces

sops.title_seed: SOP: Implant dose, energy, and angle verification
sops.observable_context_en: electrical or monitor data suggests an implant dose, energy, angle, or particle problem
sops.observable_context_zh: electrical或monitor data提示implant dose、energy、angle或particle问题
procedure_steps: separate dose, energy, and spatial signatures
sops.engineering_boundary: One implant dimension cannot close another dimension's question

sops.observable_context_en: thermal, atmosphere, uniformity, or boat-slot monitors indicate a furnace excursion
sops.engineering_boundary: Use spatial and slot evidence before assigning furnace hardware

sops.title_seed: SOP: PVD chamber and target excursion
sops.observable_context_en: PVD thickness, resistance, void, uniformity, or particle monitors shift
sops.engineering_boundary: Separate preclean, target, and chamber-shield mechanisms

sops.title_seed: SOP: Wet-clean chemistry and dry response
sops.observable_context_en: watermark, metallic contamination, or oxide-loss monitors exceed limits
an equipment, chamber, recipe, or material excursion requires bounded impact-lot identification
sops.observable_context_zh: equipment、chamber、recipe或material excursion需要确定有边界的impact lot
procedure_steps: exclude lots outside equipment and chamber scope
record source and impacted lots separately
sops.engineering_boundary: Impact scope is exposure evidence, not proof of the root cause

sops.observable_context_en: a measurement shift may reflect process change or measurement-system error
sops.observable_context_zh: measurement shift可能来自process change或measurement-system error
sops.engineering_boundary: Unverified measurements cannot confirm a process root cause

sops.observable_context_en: an FDC feature is abnormal but sensor quality or context may be uncertain
sops.observable_context_zh: FDC feature异常，但sensor quality或context存在不确定性
sops.engineering_boundary: A bad sensor cannot be used as supporting process evidence

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: pad and retaining-ring aging can create distinct spatial removal and scratch patterns
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: pad与retaining-ring老化可能形成不同的spatial removal与scratch pattern
engineering_notes.interpretation: Center-edge maps and repeatable scratch geometry help separate consumable mechanisms from slurry delivery
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: The note is background guidance and cannot replace lot-specific evidence

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: endpoint extension may result from true removal loss or optical-signal degradation
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: endpoint extension可能来自真实removal loss或optical-signal degradation
engineering_notes.interpretation: Compare endpoint, removal rate, slurry flow, and sensor health before assigning mechanism
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Endpoint duration alone is not root-cause evidence

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: post-clean chambers may exhibit transient rate and particle behavior before stabilization
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: post-clean chamber在稳定前可能出现transient rate与particle变化
engineering_notes.interpretation: Separate expected seasoning transients from persistent chamber faults using wafer sequence
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Local process specifications determine the acceptable seasoning window

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: focus, dose, bake, develop, and edge-bead failures create different map and profile signatures
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: focus、dose、bake、develop与edge-bead failure具有不同map和profile signature
engineering_notes.interpretation: Use defect orientation and monitor separation to localize scanner versus track mechanisms
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: The signature narrows investigation but does not confirm hardware failure

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: etch rate, profile, selectivity, residue, and endpoint respond to different process dimensions
engineering_notes.interpretation: RF, pressure, chemistry, and endpoint evidence should be mapped to the property they can explain
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Cross-property correlation is not automatically causal

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: dose, energy, angle, and endstation contamination require different monitor evidence
engineering_notes.interpretation: Electrical and spatial signatures should be mapped to the implant dimension being tested
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: A normal dose monitor cannot rule out energy or angle faults

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: zone, radial, and boat-slot patterns provide different clues for thermal and atmosphere mechanisms
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: zone、radial与boat-slot pattern为thermal及atmosphere mechanism提供不同线索
engineering_notes.interpretation: Combine temperature, atmosphere, wafer map, and slot history before assigning hardware
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Average values can hide spatial excursions

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: target, shield, magnet, and preclean aging affect different electrical, spatial, and particle outputs
engineering_notes.interpretation: Maintenance counters are useful context only when they align with physical signals
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Counter expiry alone is not proof of causation

engineering_notes.title_seed: Engineering note: Wet-clean bath and dry separation
engineering_notes.observable_context_en: metal contamination, oxide loss, and watermarks localize to different bath or dry dimensions
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: metal contamination、oxide loss与watermark对应不同bath或dry dimension
engineering_notes.interpretation: Incoming inspection and sub-step localization prevent unrelated chemistry changes
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Concentration and bath-life evidence must use qualified measurement methods

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: scratch orientation, repeatability, and first-detection operation help localize process versus handling sources
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: scratch orientation、repeatability与first-detection operation有助于定位process或handling source
engineering_notes.interpretation: First detection is not always first creation; compare upstream inspections and wafer maps
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: A visual pattern narrows hypotheses but needs exposure evidence

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: apparent process shifts can originate from calibration, repeatability, sampling, or real process change
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: apparent process shift可能来自calibration、repeatability、sampling或真实process change
engineering_notes.interpretation: Reference wafers and repeat measurements separate measurement-system hypotheses
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Unqualified data must be marked unavailable rather than treated as normal

engineering_notes.observable_context_en: historical similarity can propose hypotheses but cannot confirm the current incident
engineering_notes.observable_context_zh: historical similarity可以提出hypothesis，但不能确认当前incident
engineering_notes.interpretation: Current-lot evidence must validate any mechanism suggested by retrieved cases
engineering_notes.engineering_boundary: Knowledge matches are supporting evidence only
